meaning:
ἔντιμος, -ον
(τιμή), [in LXX for חוֹר, etc. ;]
honoured, prized, precious: of persons, Luk.7:2, Php.2:29; compar., Luk.14:8; of things, metaphorically, λίθος, 1Pe.2:4 2:6" (LXX) .†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.
